items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: Ohio Tax Credit AuthorityがMicrosoft Corporationに対し、Licking County(New Albany/Heath/Hebron)のプロジェクトに15年間100%の税額控除(JCTC)を承認。新規雇用20人・新規年間給与$2Mが条件。
items.infer: 受領者・地域からデータセンター関連投資の可能性が高く(推論)、電源設備・冷却装置・搬送機器などの需要が生じる可能性がある(推論)。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a tax exemption (Data Center Sales Tax Exemption or JCTC-type exemption) of 100% for 15 years on 2024-10-28 for a project in the City of New Albany, City of Heath, and Village of Hebron, Licking County. Commitment: create 20 full-time equivalent employees generatin

items.program: Data Center Sales and Use Tax Exemption
items.program_name: Data Center Sales and Use Tax Exemption(WI WEDC・Technical Assistance)
items.summary: WisconsinのWEDCがMicrosoftに対しMount Pleasant(Racine County)のデータセンター建設に関する売上・使用税免除の技術支援を承認。予定投資額は$150M(プロジェクト全体費用は$1,000M)。
items.infer: 大規模データセンター新設に伴い、電源設備・冷却装置・サーバーラック搬送機器などの需要が発生する可能性(推論)。
items.verbatim: WEDC Technical Assistance under the Data Center Sales and Use Tax Exemption program, awarded 2024-07-23 in Village of Mount Pleasant, Racine County. Industry: Info and Comm. Planned project cost: $1,000,000,000. Planned capital investment: $150,000,000. Deliverables: Capital Investment.

items.summary: Illinois DCEOのEDGE税額控除($1.92M)がMicrosoft Corporationに承認され、シカゴで新規雇用60人を目標とする事業拡大を支援する。
items.verbatim: Illinois EDGE tax credit agreement executed 02/15/2022. Project location: Chicago. New employee jobs target: 60. Retained employee jobs target: 0. Estimated value of credit: $1,916,250.00. Located in underserved area: No.
